title: rcs_campaign
description: EchoForge rcs_campaign document. Pins a radar-cross-section sweep: which object_card, which solver_card, the frequency and azimuth ranges, polarization pair, and run count. Conforms to the EchoForge strict-open contract: deterministic id, public-proxy provenance, and validation envelope.

id.description: Deterministic EchoForge id of the form ef:<kind>:<public_proxy_id>:<16hex>:1. Derived from the identity-field payload.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator. Always the literal string 'rcs_campaign' for this schema.

schema_version.description: EchoForge schema version pin. Must equal '1.0.0' for this revision of the contract.

public_proxy_id.description: Stable, human-readable slug identifying the public-proxy campaign subject (lowercase letters, digits, and ._- separators). Forms part of the deterministic id.

provenance.description: Provenance envelope: how the document was produced, source references, generator, timestamp, and payload fingerprint.

license.description: License envelope (SPDX id and optional notice) under which the rcs_campaign content is released.

validation.description: Validation envelope: tier, overall status, uncertainty score, and the per-check results that establish trust in this document.

campaign_name.description: Human-readable campaign name shown in tools and reports. Non-empty free text.

object_card_id.description: Deterministic id of the object_card document this campaign targets.

solver_card_id.description: Deterministic id of the solver_card document used to compute this campaign.

frequency_range_hz.description: Frequency sweep band in Hz. Requires max >= min and min > 0.

azimuth_deg.description: Azimuth sweep range in degrees. Requires max >= min; typical bounds lie within [-180, 360].

tx_polarization.description: Transmit polarization. One of 'H' (horizontal), 'V' (vertical), 'L' (left circular), or 'R' (right circular).

rx_polarization.description: Receive polarization. One of 'H' (horizontal), 'V' (vertical), 'L' (left circular), or 'R' (right circular).

run_count.description: Number of solver runs scheduled by this campaign. Must be a positive integer (>= 1).
